segments_b.text: I've walked through shadows, carried the pain, silent battles left me standing in the rain.
The weight of memories I couldn't release
But broken pieces can still find peace
Every scar tells a story I've survived
Every tear was a lesson keeping me alive
I am healing, slowly breathing, finding strength in the cracks of my soul.
I am rising, not just surviving, letting go of what I can control.
Step by step, my heart is revealing, I am healing
The echoes of sorrow don't haunt like before
I'm learning forgiveness, I'm needing it more
The silence inside me is starting to sing
A fragile beginning, but hope takes away
Every scar tells a story I've survived
Every tear was a lesson keeping me alive
I am healing, slowly breathing
Finding strength in the cracks of my soul
I am rising, not just surviving
Letting go of what I can control
Step by step, my heart is revealing
And I am healing
There's a light in the distance
Calling my name
Through the fire, I'll never be the same
The pieces are mending, I'm learning to feel what was broken
It's finally real, I'm healing, slowly breathing
